question: Among product categories (English names) with at least 500 delivered orders, which 5 have the highest late rate?
model_sql:
WITH order_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.order_id,
           ce.product_category_name_english AS category,
           d.is_late
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN category_en ce ON ce.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
),
category_stats AS (
    SELECT category,
           COUNT(*) AS orders,
           ROUND(100.0 * AVG(is_late), 2) AS late_rate_pct
    FROM order_categories
    GROUP BY category
    HAVING orders >= 500
)
SELECT category,
       orders,
       late_rate_pct
FROM category_stats
ORDER BY late_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
gold_sql: SELECT ce.product_category_name_english, ROUND(100.0*AVG(d.is_late),2) AS r FROM delivered_orders d JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, product_id FROM order_items) oi ON oi.order_id=d.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id JOIN category_en ce ON ce.product_category_name=p.product_category_name GROUP BY ce.product_category_name_english HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id)>=500 ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 5

question: Among customer states with at least 1000 single-seller delivered orders, which has the highest share of cross-state orders?
model_sql:
WITH single_seller AS (
    SELECT
        customer_state,
        CASE WHEN same_state = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_cross_state
    FROM delivered_orders
    WHERE n_sellers = 1
),
state_counts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_state,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        SUM(is_cross_state) AS cross_orders
    FROM single_seller
    GROUP BY customer_state
    HAVING total_orders >= 1000
)
SELECT
    customer_state,
    ROUND(100.0 * cross_orders / total_orders, 2) AS cross_state_share_pct,
    total_orders
FROM state_counts
ORDER BY cross_state_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1
